raw_segments.text: Why didst thou send me forth, brave Cassius? Did I not meet thy friends? And did not they
put on my brows this wreath of victory, and bid me give it thee? Didst thou not hear their
shouts? Alas, thou hast misconstrued everything. But hold thee, take this garland on thy brow,
thy Brutus bid me give it thee, and I will do his bidding. Brutus, come apace and see
how I regarded Caius Cassius. By your leave, gods, this is a Roman's part. Come, Cassius'
